From: Emily Carter <emily@oncosolve.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@biorisk.org>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment demo request — OncoSolve

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick signup — we completed the self-serve flow and indicated we need a private deployment (VPC / customer-managed network). We're OncoSolve (clinical-stage therapeutics) and need to evaluate Redwood for patient data processing in our research workflows. Security is our main blocker: tenant isolation, KMS integration, audit logs, and retention controls.

Would love to schedule a technical demo focused on:
- Architecture options (VPC, on-prem air-gapped, hybrid)
- KMS/HSM integrations and encryption-at-rest details
- Evidence and attestation (SOC2, logs, data residency)
- Typical timeline for Private deployment POC

Our security lead (cc'd) will join. We're available this week: Tue/Wed mornings (PT) or Thu afternoon. I've attached a short intake form with our high-level requirements and a list of attendees.

Attachments: oncosolve-poc-intake.pdf (PDF - 2 pages)

Best,
Emily Carter
Program Manager, Research IT
OncoSolve Therapeutics
emily@oncosolve.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0148

--

Hi Emily — great to meet you and thanks for the intake form. Happy to run a focused technical walkthrough.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2027-03-16, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2027-03-17, 09:00–10:00
- Thu 2027-03-18, 15:00–16:00

Suggested agenda (30–45m):
1) Intro + objectives (5 min)
2) Deployment modes & network topology (10 min)
3) Security integrations (KMS, audit logs, RBAC) (15 min)
4) Timeline, next steps, evidence we can provide (10 min)

I've attached our pre-demo ops checklist — can you confirm whether:
- You require an IP allowlist or private peering?
- You have an internal KMS (if so, vendor & key exchange requirements)
- Any regulatory constraints for data residency?

I'll loop in Dev (solutions engineer) and Vivek (sales lead) to ensure we cover procurement and SLA questions during the call. Please confirm which slot works and who will attend from your side.

Attachments: redwood-pre-demo-checklist.pdf (PDF - 1 page)

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Connect: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/ai-demo-aisha
